# ISTQB-PREP

> An open-source, free, bilingual (TR/EN) mock exam and study platform for ISTQB certification exam preparation.
> **Priority: Foundation Level — CTFL v4.0.1.** The architecture is designed to cover all other levels and modules.

**Status:** 🚧 Working MVP — the mock exam works end to end.
**Deployment:** GitHub Pages (static, free, serverless)

## Problem

A candidate preparing for the ISTQB exam in Turkey currently runs into:

- **The official source is PDF-only.** The TTB and ISTQB publish the syllabus and the 4 sample exams (A/B/C/D) as PDFs. Questions and answers sit in separate files, there's no timer, no progress tracking, no explanations. You burn out in one evening.
- **Interactive Turkish content is close to nonexistent.** All the free Turkish practice content out there is just the same 160 official questions republished in different places. The only interactive Turkish mock exam is an embedded Microsoft Form.
- **Online question banks are rotten.** The largest free English bank (~1,360 questions) doesn't even state which syllabus version it's for; a paid iOS app is still on the retired 2021 syllabus as of September 2026. The standard advice in the industry has become _"stay away from online practice tests."_
- **Miscalibrated pass mark.** A popular free practice site applies a 50% pass threshold; the real pass mark is **26/40 (65%)**.
- **Cost gap.** The TTB CTFL exam costs 5.950 ₺ + VAT; accredited training costs ~30.000 ₺ + VAT. There's no serious, purchasable Turkish prep product in between. The Foundation failure rate is 25–30%.

## Solution

A prep platform faithful to the syllabus's own structure — tagged by **learning objective (LO) and K-level**, **explaining why each distractor is wrong**, usable **side by side in TR/EN**, and running entirely client-side.

### Core differentiators

| #   | Feature                                                                                                               | Who else does this?                     |
| --- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Native-Turkish, terminologically accurate original question bank                                                      | Nobody                                  |
| 2   | Questions **side by side in TR/EN**, like the real exam booklet                                                       | Only one Udemy course with 161 students |
| 3   | Every question tagged with **LO code + K-level**, plus per-LO weakness analysis                                       | Nobody (in any language)                |
| 4   | **Per-distractor rationale** — "why this option is wrong"                                                             | Almost nobody                           |
| 5   | A visible **syllabus version badge** + a retirement policy                                                            | Nobody                                  |
| 6   | A realistic mock exam generated from the official **LO-group distribution** (40 questions / 26 pass mark / 60–75 min) | Nobody                                  |
| 7   | **Spaced repetition (SRS)** applied to exam questions                                                                 | Nobody                                  |

Detailed rationale and sources: [`docs/01-market-research.md`](docs/01-market-research.md)

## What works

| Area                         | Status                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Data skeleton                | ✅ Extracted from the official syllabus — 64 learning objectives, 29 LO groups, 97 terms |
| Exam engine                  | ✅ Blueprint-based generation, exact-match scoring, 39 unit tests                        |
| Exam screen                  | ✅ Drift-free timer, question navigator, fully usable by keyboard                        |
| Results + review             | ✅ Pass-mark line, section and LO breakdown, option-by-option rationale                  |
| Question pool                | ✅ 120 questions published, 64/64 learning objectives covered · Phase 2 target: 200      |
| Practice mode, SRS, glossary | ⬜ Phase 2-3                                                                             |

**Data accuracy.** The exam constants, learning objectives, and Turkish terms
were extracted from the official ISTQB and TTB PDFs; none of it was hand-guessed.
The Turkish term glossary was built by positionally aligning the chapter-opening
keyword lists of both syllabi — the term counts matched exactly across all
six chapters. Details: [`data/ctfl-v4.0.1/terms.json`](data/ctfl-v4.0.1/terms.json)

## Technical summary

```
Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5
Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui + Radix primitives
Zustand (state) · Dexie/IndexedDB (persistence) · i18next (TR/EN)
ts-fsrs (spaced repetition) · vite-plugin-pwa (offline)
Data: indexed, chunked static JSON under /public/data
No backend · No accounts · No server cost · GitHub Pages
```

Rationale: [`docs/adr/0001-frontend-stack.md`](docs/adr/0001-frontend-stack.md)
